look.text: A new millstone, pale and veined, much finer than the old one leaning by the wall.

known.text: The new millstone is pale and veined with something that glints even in shade. Its dust washes into the wheel-race, and the Lanes' new pipe draws from right there. Stamped on its side: "Seam-stone, Karrowdeep. Licensed by the River Compact."

wedged.text: You hammer a wooden wedge into the pipe's mouth. The Lanes will have to draw from the river for a while, but the river tastes of the river.

closed.text: The pipe's wedged shut. The millstone keeps turning.
